result.summary: Vodafone Idea currently has one open overdue invoice (INR 9.0M, 18 days past due, out of a 90-day term and INR 120M limit on policy TCI-SCF-2026-0001). Resolution times for prior overdues have been lengthening (5 days late in March, 9 days late in July), and the current overdue has already exceeded both, while notification frequency ticked up from 1 to 2 in the last six months on the same policy. This is still a single policy/single insurer exposure with ageing concentrated in the 1-30 day bucket, but the pattern warrants closer monitoring.
concerns: Days-late on resolved overdues has been increasing (5 -> 9 days) and the current open overdue at 18 DPD already exceeds both prior episodes
Notification count rose from 1 to 2 in the trailing six-month window, suggesting mild accumulation
All exposure and limit granting is concentrated with a single insurer/policy (TCI-SCF-2026-0001), limiting diversification of risk signal
